name: What costs should I expect for a personal injury case?

mainEntity.name: What costs should I expect for a personal injury case?

acceptedAnswer.text: Personal injury cases are handled on a contingency fee basis—no payment unless you win—and upfront costs like investigations, records, and expert fees are advanced by the firm. This risk-free approach ensures that money isn’t a barrier to powerful legal advocacy for injury victims in California.angeloreyeslaw+2​
